workingTitle: 协同特征、位姿、标定与模型版本的原子快照

evidenceBoundary.verified: Public cooperative-perception implementations carry feature, delay, and transform objects separately without one common model and calibration epoch, and public robustness code provides a real cross-time object-tearing injection path.
evidenceBoundary.unverified: No audited paper, incident report, or public vehicle log demonstrates an actual feature generated under epoch E0 being fused with E1 pose, extrinsic, or decoder state.

verifiedEntrypoints.finding: Feature tensors, time_delay, and spatial_correction_matrix are constructed and consumed through separable fields, enabling controlled paired injection without proving a naturally occurring fault.
The public temporal-misalignment corruption selects a non-ego camera file from another timestamp while retaining current YAML and LiDAR, providing a concrete cross-time tearing template.
Atomicity covers one node's parameter set, not feature, transform, model, and calibration state across nodes and topics.
Coherent sets provide a transport transaction primitive but do not establish model, calibration, coordinate, or schema compatibility.
The message provides reference time, position, sensor identity, and relative measurement time but no audited encoder version, extrinsic hash, or calibration epoch.

nearestWorkBoundary.occupiedSpace: Temporal compensation and asynchronous fusion, not version identity.
Estimation or tolerance of numeric transform errors, not pairing a feature with the configuration that produced it.
Mapping known heterogeneous model domains through adapters, not transactionally binding rolling versions per feature packet.

twoWeekGoNoGo: Reproduce one clean OpenCOOD baseline and official asynchronous or localization-noise control before injecting version faults.
Construct E0 and E1 pose, extrinsic, and checkpoint states and add unguarded, epoch-equality, and oracle-compatible receivers.
Compare coherent-stale and torn bundles at identical feature age, transform-error norm, model pair, and network delay.
Run paired scene bootstrap and report accepted-but-worse-than-ego silent failures, rejection, coverage, and overhead.
Proceed only if bundle pairing has an incremental effect after the component magnitudes are controlled.
injectionAxes: Pose: translation up to 1 m and yaw up to 5 degrees
Extrinsic update: translation up to 10 cm and rotation up to 1 degree
Model: coherent M0 or M1 and crossed encoder-adapter or decoder pairs
Transport: ordered, reordered, or one missing bundle component
falsifiableClaims: At controlled age, transform-error norm, and model pair, torn bundles cause larger paired loss than coherent-stale bundles.
An epoch and compatibility gate reduces silent failure without collapsing useful cooperation to ego-only.
Calibration-by-time or calibration-by-model interactions exceed the corresponding additive component effects.
Existing temporal or spatial correction leaves an identifiable incremental loss under epoch mismatch.
killCriteria: The clean baseline cannot be reproduced within three working days.
Pairing has no incremental effect on two datasets and two fusion models after component controls.
Effects appear only beyond the preregistered perturbation range.
The guard gains safety only by rejecting nearly all cooperation.
Any broader real-deployment claim requires unavailable production version history or logs.
